description: This file contains selector functions for retrieving thread-related data from the global state in a Mattermost Redux-based application. It includes functions to get threads in a team, unread threads, thread counts, specific threads, and threads in channels, utilizing memoized selectors.

methods.name: getThreadsInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all threads in a specific team from the global state.

methods.name: getUnreadThreadsInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all unread threads in a specific team.

methods.name: getThreadsInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Gets thread IDs in the current team using a memoized selector.

methods.name: getUnreadThreadsInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Gets unread thread IDs in the current team using a memoized selector.

methods.name: getThreadCounts
methods.description: Returns thread counts from the state.

methods.name: getThreadCountsIncludingDirect
methods.description: Returns thread counts including direct messages.

methods.name: getThreadCountsInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Gets thread counts for the current team.

methods.name: getThreads
methods.description: Retrieves all threads as an object mapping thread IDs to thread data.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves a specific thread by ID.

methods.name: makeGetThreadOrSynthetic
methods.description: Creates a selector to get a thread or a synthetic thread based on a post.

methods.name: getThreadOrderInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Gets thread IDs ordered by last reply in the current team.

methods.name: getNewestThreadInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves the newest thread in a specified team.

methods.name: getUnreadThreadOrderInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Gets unread thread IDs ordered by last reply in the current team.

methods.name: sortByLastReply
methods.description: Helper function to sort thread IDs by last reply timestamp.

methods.name: getThreadsInChannel
methods.description: Retrieves all threads in a specific channel.
